# gtk4's widget declarations are the gir: scheme's package -- a library
# plugin, lib/x/scheme/gir -- and sngl:platform/gtk4's wrappers import it. A
# program naming a widget directly imports it the same way.

# The platform package checks on its own, where nothing but the library
# resolves its import.
sngl check sngl:platform/gtk4

# A program reaches a widget, and a GIR action on it, through the import.
sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt gir=builtin --out=out app.sngl
grep 'gtk_progress_bar_pulse' out/model.go

# The widgets are no longer sngl:platform/gtk4's.
! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt gir=builtin --out=old old.sngl
stderr 'GtkProgressBar'

-- app.sngl --
import gtk "gir:Gtk-4.0"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"

ui.window {
    gtk.GtkProgressBar #bar(fraction=0.0) {}
    time.timer(interval=100ms, @tick { bar.pulse() })
}
-- old.sngl --
import "sngl:platform/gtk4"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    gtk4.GtkProgressBar(fraction=0.0) {}
}
